solution: The records may improve predictions and help plan resources. However, secondary use without informed consent or weak access controls can expose sensitive information and discriminate against groups. Data minimization, appropriate consent, secure access and fairness review are needed; useful predictions do not automatically justify unrestricted collection.

marking_points.criterion: Develops use of data for prediction.
